Select the ChEMBL ID, preferred name, maximum clinical phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for all compounds reported in the specified document. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, filter by doc_id corresponding to CHEMBL1125208, and join compound_structures to retrieve canonical SMILES. Return the columns molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, and canonical_smiles. Sort the results by molecule_chembl_id.
